# Matthew Payne Consulting

> High-trust, peer-to-peer client and investor growth for financial advisors, fund managers raising capital, and estate & business attorneys. Founded by Matthew Payne: twenty years of consulting, three thousand seminars and trainings, 325+ clients across 107 industries. Operations are powered by Jarvis, an agentic AI operator that runs research, qualification, outreach, follow-up, booking, and monitoring around the clock.

## What Matthew Payne Consulting does
- Capital raising: builds standing, peer to peer, with real allocators and high net worth investors for fund managers and GPs. Client results include $100M, $60M, and $35M raises.
- Financial advisors: high net worth and ultra high net worth client acquisition systems (the High-Net-Worth Client Attraction & Conversion System) and 1-on-1 weekly strategic marketing consulting.
- The System (flagship online hybrid training): The High Net Worth Client & Investor Attraction & Conversion System — a structured online course plus live coaching, delivered to enrolled clients through the private course portal at https://portal.matthewpayneconsulting.com/. Covers premium client targeting, LinkedIn Sales Navigator strategy, positioning, high-converting messaging, and call proficiency for advisors, fund managers, and attorneys.
- Estate & business attorneys: high net worth client acquisition for legal practices.
- Optimal Performance Business & Life Coaching: private one-on-one coaching across psychology, strategy, habits, and energy.

## Jarvis (agentic technology)
Jarvis is the agentic AI operator behind Matthew Payne Consulting — an executive mind built as an extension of the professional it serves: their personality, vocabulary, and judgment. Jarvis runs the full client-acquisition sequence around the clock: prospect research, qualification against the client's standards, outreach written in the client's own voice across email and LinkedIn, follow-up with perfect memory, meeting booking and pre-meeting briefings, CRM upkeep, campaign management, deliverability and pipeline monitoring, and a daily morning briefing. One operator with the output of a marketing team, a research analyst, and an assistant who never sleeps. Full page: https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/jarvis.html
